note: Live Random trace of orig/g.exe under qemu+gdb with RandSeed pinned by patching a COPY of the binary, and its draw-by-draw comparison against the static catalogue in data/wander.json.  Ground truth is the original only; nothing here comes from src/.  Verdicts are corroborated / not observed / contradicted; a contradiction is reported with both readings, never reconciled away.  Method and addresses: docs/re/rng-trace.md.

observation_point.what: the `retf word 0x2` at the tail of Random(Word); SP is back at its entry value so [sp]=return offset, [sp+2]=return segment, [sp+4]=n, and ax already holds the result

turn_marker.what: the top-level prompt's ReadLn call (9a c6 06 78 0f)

context.note: What each run's computed `n` should be, and where every operand came from.  Nothing here is assumed.

order_check.note: Asserted, not eyeballed: within every turn, the preamble draws observed must appear in catalogued ordinal order (1..14), each at most once.  compare() matches on call site and `n` only, so without this a re-run whose order had drifted would still read as corroborated.  The church's draws 15..18 fire nested inside another routine and are outside this check.

comparison.detail: computed n: `chapter * 20` = 20 in this run's state (district 1 and class 6 read from the guest's own DS:3692 / DS:389c at the end of run B; the class growth weights are read from orig/g.exe); computed n: `chapter * 20` = 60 in this run's state (district 3 and class 6 read from the guest's own DS:3692 / DS:389c at the end of run E; the class growth weights are read from orig/g.exe)

computed n: `chapter * 5` = 5 in this run's state (district 1 and class 6 read from the guest's own DS:3692 / DS:389c at the end of run B; the class growth weights are read from orig/g.exe); computed n: `chapter * 5` = 15 in this run's state (district 3 and class 6 read from the guest's own DS:3692 / DS:389c at the end of run E; the class growth weights are read from orig/g.exe)

comparison.catalogued_n: sum of the four class growth weights: byte[DS: class*4 + 2] + byte[DS: class*4 + 3] + byte[DS: class*4 + 4] + byte[DS: class*4 + 5], computed at 1000:25aa..1000:25ee into [bp-0x6]
comparison.gate: draw 15 returned exactly 0 (1000:7f68 `cmp ax,0x0` / 1000:7f6b `jz 0x7f70`) AND, inside 1000:2526, level [0x38a6] != 40 (1000:2580 `cmp word [0x38a6],0x28` / 1000:2585 `jnz 0x258a`; reached because the church pushes param 0, tested at 1000:257a `cmp byte [bp+0x4],0x0`). At level 40 the routine jumps to 1000:28a0 and spends NO draw.

shared_call_site.note: draw(s) 18 fire at this SAME address and cannot be told apart by it.  `observed_count` here is that one set of stops, reported once per catalogued ordinal -- it must not be added across these entries as if they were independent observations.  What the trace corroborates is HOW MANY draws the arm spends at this address, not which ordinal each stop is.

comparison.detail: computed n: `sum of the four class growth weights: byte[DS: class*4 + 2] + byte[DS: class*4 + 3] + byte[DS: class*4 + 4] + byte[DS: class*4 + 5], computed at 1000:25aa..1000:25ee into [bp-0x6]` = 12 in this run's state (district 1 and class 3 read from the guest's own DS:3692 / DS:389c at the end of run C; the class growth weights are read from orig/g.exe)

comparison.catalogued_n: same weight_sum as draw 17 -- [bp-0x6] is not recomputed between iterations
comparison.gate: same gate as draw 17. The inner loop counter [bp-0x8] is initialised to 1 at 1000:25f1 (`c7 46 f8 01 00`), incremented at 1000:25f8, and the bound at 1000:287d is `cmp word [bp-0x8],0x2` / 1000:2881 `jz 0x2886` / 1000:2883 `jmp 0x25f8` -- exactly two iterations, so exactly two draws per level gained.
